page_title: MAI 2-0 BOC | Mainz v Bochum 11/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) finds his way to a rebound inside the six-yard box thanks to his strength and unleashes a strike towards goal, but it ricochets away off one of his teammates.
90+3' Matus Bero (Bochum) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
90+3' The corner from Matus Bero (Bochum) is cleared away by the defence.
90+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bochum. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bochum will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+1' Nelson Weiper (Mainz) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jae-Sung Lee.
90+1' Here is a change. Anthony Caci is going off and Bo Henriksen gives the last tactical orders to Silvan Widmer (Mainz).
90+1' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Moritz Jenz walks off the pitch to be replaced by Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz).
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
85' Anthony Caci (Mainz) is adjudged offside.
82' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
81' The linesman signals that Anthony Caci (Mainz) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
79' Mainz failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
79' The attendance is 33000.

78' Jakov Medic (Bochum) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
78' Felix Passlack (Bochum) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Bochum win a corner.
78' The linesman makes the right call and Bochum will have a corner.
77' The ball is out of play. Bochum will have a chance to score from a corner.
75' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) fires a wonderful strike towards goal, but it's a whisker wide of the right post.
73' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Anthony Caci (Mainz) heads on.
71' Bo Henriksen has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Armindo Sieb (Mainz) replacing Jonathan Burkardt.
71' Dani de Wit (Bochum) out-muscles his marker and gets the ball from the corner kick. He produces a shot, but it goes way wide of the left post. High, wide and not pretty at all.
71' It will be a corner kick for Bochum.
71' Myron Boadu (Bochum) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Robin Zentner.
70' Dieter Hecking prepares a substitution. Moritz Broschinski is replaced by Myron Boadu (Bochum).
70' Here's the change. Ivan Ordets leaves the pitch and Erhan Masovic (Bochum) comes on as a substitute.

69' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Phillipp Mwene plays the ball to the feet of Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz), who hits a tremendous first-time shot into the top left corner. The goalkeeper was unable to keep it out. 2:0.
65' Maximilian Wittek comes off the pitch to be replaced by Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum).
65' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
64' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
61' Mainz enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
57' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Mainz! Play can continue.
56' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Mainz! Let's see what he decides.
56' That looked a certain handball by Ivan Ordets (Bochum) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
55' Felix Passlack (Bochum) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
54' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
50' Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
46' Dieter Hecking has made a change at the break. Dani de Wit (Bochum) has come on in place of Anthony Losilla.
46' The second half has just started.
45+9' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+8' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Anthony Caci (Mainz), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
45+7' Benjamin Brand shows a yellow card to Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
45+5' What a sensational goal that would have been! Anthony Caci (Mainz) picks up the ball inside the box and fires a beautiful first-time shot, but it goes just a few inches wide of the right post.
45+3' Mainz work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
45+3' Anthony Caci (Mainz) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
45+2' Bernardo (Bochum) heads the ball towards goal, but his effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
45' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
43' Moritz Jenz (Mainz) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
41' The game is interrupted now, Moritz Jenz (Mainz) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
39' Anthony Caci (Mainz) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
37' Paul Nebel (Mainz) is being substituted because of an injury. Bo Henriksen sends Hyun-Seok Hong on the pitch.
35' Jakov Medic (Bochum) latches on to a cross but heads the ball miles wide of the right post. Such a bad header.
33' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Benjamin Brand's book.
31' Bochum are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
29' Patrick Drewes pulls off a run-of-the-mill save from a header by Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) after a cross from the side.
29' Mainz take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
27' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

23' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) scores with a brilliant shot into the middle of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Anthony Caci. The score is now 1:0.
22' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Patrick Drewes.
20' Dieter Hecking is forced to make a change. Tim Oermann (Bochum) is unable to continue due to injury, Jakov Medic comes on.
16' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
15' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) is caught offside!
14' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) is able to continue to play.
13' Tim Oermann (Bochum) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

10' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) makes a good late run into the box and times his jump perfectly to get on the end of the corner kick, but his close-range header is brilliant blocked to deny him a certain goal.
8' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
8' Mainz will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
8' A header by Moritz Jenz (Mainz) from very close range goes towards the crossbar, but doesn't get past Patrick Drewes, who makes a brilliant save.
5' Moritz Jenz (Mainz) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
3' Benjamin Brand has a clear sight and sees a foul from Kaishu Sano (Mainz).
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Bochum will kick the game off.
Benjamin Brand will officiate today.
